newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to toughen privatisation rules - Chubais.
newsitem.headline: Russia to toughen privatisation rules - Chubais.

text.p: The Russian government will stick to its new principle that privatisation must raise as much money as possible, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday.
"We have drawn up the rules of government cooperation with financial structures of all kinds," Chubais said.
"Svyazinvest auction is the first harbinger. But it was carried out in the way we had promised -- those who put up the biggest amount of financial resources win, regardless of any kind of pressure."

The treasury raised $1.875 billion from selling a quarter of telecoms holding Svyazinvest last month-- much higher than the reserve price and the losing bid, in what economists say was the first relatively fair and competitive privatisation tender.
Chubais said the government was working on a draft decree on privatisation.
"The principles of privatisation which we adhered to in recent auctions are not to be changed, but we shall adhere to them even more strictly."
